Yes — taken all together, that's the finding experience I wanted. I can just type and watch it narrow, quote something when I need those exact words, widen to "any of these" when I'm casting about, lean on my labels to include or leave things out with a tap, mix a label with a typed word to pinpoint, and still drop down to typed shortcuts if I'm moving fast. Between the plain search and this richer one, I feel like I could always get back to what I meant, whether my library's small or big.

So the finding flow matches my intent now. That's settled for me. I think the last big thing on my original wish list is the "read later" spot — the place that keeps my unfinished reading in front of me — so I'm ready to look at that whenever you are.
